Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27419` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27419 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Filed p3 `domain:ui` `area:ai` (filing gate ① reproduced, zh-CN). The card offers "name them" or "hide them". **Seat pick: name them.** The build really stages datasets and permission sets, and hiding them would make the progress list disagree with what lands in the app. zh 「数据集」 and 「权限」, with en `Datasets` / `Permissions` and the matching word in every other locale that carries `chatbot.build.group`. The `default:` branch never prints a raw type identifier again: it returns a neutral 「其他」 / `Other` group key. No other wording in the panel changes.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure on `origin/main` after `3bfb357a`; disproof welcome)

- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` ~:5065 `useBuildGroupLabel`: a static switch (`object / view / dashboard / app / seed`) with `default: return type`. It is static on purpose (the comment at ~:1246 explains why a computed key is avoided); keep it static and add `dataset`, `permission` and the `other` fallback as literal cases/keys.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: all ten of ar/de/en/es/fr/ja/ko/pt/ru/zh carry a `build` block with the five `group` keys (zh ~:3946). Add the three keys to every one of them so the parity/dead-key gates hold. Open PR #27340 (currency, draft) also edits all ten locale files, in other blocks; rebase rather than hand-merge if it lands first.
- The full set of artifact types `apply_blueprint` stages is cloud-side (cloud#3310). Find the frame type's type union or fixture in this repo (`git grep -n "blueprint-progress\|apply_blueprint" -- ui/packages packages`); if the union lives here, the unit test iterates it so a new type without a label goes red; if it does not, list the seven observed types (object, view, dashboard, app, seed, dataset, permission) and say so in the report.

### Scope

File surface: `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, the ten locale files, a new pin `useBuildGroupLabel` test in `plugin-chatbot` (renders a frame with every staged type and asserts no group name equals its raw type; zh and en), and one patch changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` + `@object-ui/i18n` in the root `.changeset/`. Ablation: restore `default: return type` ⇒ the pin goes red on an unknown type. Stay under 120 changed lines.

### Tier

Quote `dispatch-gates --tier`. Expected none (seat ran it on the paths: no path-derived mandate). `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `low`. `Clause-②: no` (new translation keys are not a published accept set; say so if the gate reads otherwise). `Metadata-protocol: none`. `Fixes #27419`.
